review_method: Complete inventory/integrity review, direct representative image inspection, and comparison of every capture with the relevant preserved prior view. No automatic approval in CI.
rationale: Representative desktop, laptop and narrow states preserve readable controls, wrapping, evidence warnings, frozen population/version context and method-blind review. Observations, completion, population freezing and authoritative publication remain visibly distinct. No significant unexplained overlap or clipping was found. All 145 image hashes equal their corresponding preserved prior views; the six previously overwritten selection states now have distinct captured files. Native WebKit controls/font rendering are intentionally separate from Chromium baselines.
limitations: Representative inspection is not exhaustive accessibility certification. Existing raw-provenance masks and scroll-limited reader subjects remain unchanged; masked/offscreen content is not visually certified. Functional assertions test scientific state and reader reachability. Playwright WebKit is not native Safari or native MacBook acceptance.
pixel_policy: Unchanged: channel tolerance 16, changed ratio 0.0005, tile ratio 0.02. No new masks, cropping, hidden content or tolerance increases.
